priority.title: Priority and queue ordering
priority.intro: Define priority classes, choose how each {service_group} orders its queue, and check the result in a dry run before it affects anyone.
priority.classes.title: Priority classes
priority.classes.intro: A class gives its {tickets} a head start: minutes of waiting they are credited on arrival. Normal is 0. A {ticket} that waits longer than its class's maximum is escalated and served before every {ticket} that is not.
priority.classes.defaultNote: The default class always has a head start of 0 and cannot be deactivated. Give it a maximum wait to protect ordinary {tickets} from waiting too long.
priority.classes.summary: Head start: {headstart} min · Maximum wait: {maxWait} · Prefix: {prefix}
priority.classes.confirmDeactivate: {name} will no longer be offered when a {ticket} is issued. {Tickets} that already have it keep it.
priority.classes.confirmDeactivateImpact: {count} {Ticket}(s) already waiting carry this class right now; their position is not changed.
priority.strategy.title: Ordering strategy
priority.strategy.intro: Each {service_group} orders the {tickets} waiting for its services in one of these ways. A change applies the next time the queue is read; no waiting {ticket} is changed.
priority.strategy.weighted_wait: Weighted wait: wait + head start + bonuses
priority.strategy.strict_priority: Strict priority: class first, then first come first served
priority.strategy.fifo: First come first served: creation order only
priority.strategy.default: Not chosen yet: weighted wait is used.
priority.strategy.saved: Saved. The queue follows this strategy from its next read; no waiting {ticket} was changed.
priority.dryRun.title: Dry run
priority.dryRun.intro: See how every waiting {ticket} of a service is scored and ordered, without calling anyone.
priority.dryRun.empty: Nobody is waiting for this service.
priority.dryRun.note: Only weighted wait orders by score. The other strategies show the same terms but order as described above. An escalation bonus is very large on purpose: it puts an escalated {ticket} before every {ticket} that is not.

reports.feedback.intro: Rating, comment, {agent} and service, with the average rating for this filter.
reports.notification.title: Notification report
reports.notification.intro: Trigger, channel, status and cost indicator.
reports.audit.title: Audit report
reports.audit.intro: The audit trail: actor, action, entity, before and after values. Restricted to System and Organisation admins.
reports.metric.name: Name
reports.planning.title: Staffing planning views
reports.planning.intro: Peak-hours and staffing-gap views for planning staffing (SRS §16.2).
reports.planning.rangeRequired: Choose a from and to date to run this view.
reports.peakHours.title: Peak-hours view
reports.peakHours.intro: {Ticket} volume by hour of day and day of week (FR-RPT-011).
reports.staffingGap.title: Staffing-gap view
reports.staffingGap.intro: {Tickets} offered vs {counter}-hours available vs SLA attainment, per hour band (FR-RPT-012).
reports.schedule.title: Scheduled delivery
reports.schedule.intro: Schedule any report above to be emailed to a named list, daily, weekly or monthly, in a chosen format (SRS §16, FR-RPT-005).
reports.schedule.confirmDelete: Delete this schedule? It will stop sending future reports.
reports.schedule.deliveries.generationFa: The report itself failed to generate: {error}
retention.title: Retention, purge and BI access
retention.intro: How long each data class is kept before the nightly purge job acts on it (SRS §16.3, §25.4-25.5, FR-RPT-021/022, FR-SEC-032/043).
sites.hint.clinicalSensitivity: Replaces service and service-group names with a neutral label on this Site's public displays, announcements and notifications (SRS §25.3, FR-SEC-021). Required for medical deployments.
privacy.title: Privacy controls
privacy.fieldConfig.title: Configurable {visitor} fields
privacy.fieldConfig.intro: Which optional {visitor} fields are captured at registration, and which reach the kiosk confirmation screen (SRS §25.3, FR-SEC-020, FR-SEC-023).
privacy.fieldConfig.surface.kiosk_confir: Shown on the kiosk confirmation screen
privacy.fieldConfig.field.name: Name
privacy.visitorData.title: {Visitor} data export and deletion
privacy.visitorData.intro: Export everything held about one {visitor}, or anonymise their record. Deletion anonymises their {ticket} rows rather than removing them, so operational statistics survive (FR-SEC-031).
privacy.visitorData.confirmAnonymize: This permanently removes this {visitor}'s name, phone, email and {category}, and clears the note on every one of their {tickets}. This cannot be undone. Continue?
admin.labels.title: Terminology
admin.labels.intro: Rename any of these seven terms per language, without a code change (SRS §3.2). A change applies to every screen at once, including a kiosk or display already open.
admin.labels.preview.sentence: A {visitor} joins the queue for the {service_group}. The {agent} calls them to {counter} 3 to serve {ticket} A-001, filed under {category}.
setup.title: Setup wizard
setup.intro: Pick a vertical profile, build the organisation, and prove the system end to end before you go live (SRS §26.2).
setup.usersHint: Create staff users and assign roles through the Users administration API.
setup.testToken.intro: Issue one real {ticket}, print it, have an {Agent} call it from an open {counter} session, and confirm the Zone announces it — the same pipeline every {visitor} goes through (FR-OPS-010).
setup.testToken.waitingForCall: Now call this {ticket} from an open {counter} session (Console) to complete the remaining steps.
setup.goLive.blocked: Complete every step above before going live.
setup.seedCatalogue.title: Seed starter catalogue
setup.seedCatalogue.intro: Create the active profile's {service_group}, starter services and numbering rule for one site, ready to issue {tickets}. Running it again creates nothing new.
setup.featureFlags.title: Feature flags
setup.featureFlags.intro: Each flag is an org-wide master switch: the feature works only while it is on. Turning one off never cancels or changes anything already in progress — it only blocks new actions.
setup.featureFlags.confirmDisable: This turns the feature off across the whole organisation, for every site and every device, right away. Existing {tickets}, appointments and journeys are not affected.
setup.featureFlags.appointment.title: Appointments
setup.featureFlags.appointment.descripti: Booking, rescheduling, cancelling and checking in an appointment, and searching its availability.
setup.featureFlags.virtual_queue.title: Virtual queue
setup.featureFlags.virtual_queue.descrip: A registered {visitor} joining a Service's queue remotely, before arriving.
setup.featureFlags.journey.title: Journeys
setup.featureFlags.journey.description: Issuing a multi-stop journey and offering journey templates at a site.
setup.featureFlags.multi_site.title: Multiple sites
setup.featureFlags.multi_site.descriptio: Adding a second site once one is already active.
setup.featureFlags.visitor_code_lookup.d: Finding a {visitor} by their pass code or external code, at reception or the kiosk. Lookup by phone number always stays available.
setup.featureFlags.announce_visitor_name: Whether a display may announce a called {visitor}'s name, where a Service's own setting also allows it.
webhooks.title: Webhooks
webhooks.intro: Subscribe an external endpoint to any queue event type; deliveries are signed, retried, logged and replayable, and a failing endpoint never affects queuing (SRS §22.3).
ops.title: Operations
ops.diagnostics.title: Support diagnostics
ops.diagnostics.intro: Downloads a bundle with versions, a redacted configuration snapshot and recent events, for support (SRS §26.5). The download itself is recorded in the audit log.
ops.diagnostics.failed: Could not build the diagnostics bundle.
webhooks.endpoints.title: Endpoints
webhooks.endpoints.intro: Each endpoint is deactivated, never deleted, so its own delivery log keeps its history.
webhooks.endpoints.confirmDeactivate: {name} will stop receiving deliveries. Its delivery log is kept.
webhooks.endpoints.secretRevealedHint: Copy it now — it is shown only this once and cannot be read back later.
webhooks.log.title: Delivery log
admin.overview.setup.title: Setup progress
